purpose: Compute benchmark open-to-open return on exactly the same entry and maturity sessions as each stock label.
required_properties: official index series rather than ETF, portfolio ledger, strategy NAV or synthetic proxy
one unique positive open value per trading date
immutable source file with SHA-256 sidecar
immutable evidence manifest binding identity, source, path, hash, rows and coverage

acquisition_protocol.source_required: official China Securities Index historical open-price distribution or a separately approved licensed mirror with preserved raw evidence
acquisition_protocol.one_time_history_import: capture raw response/file, preserve provider identity and request parameters, normalize only date/open, write immutable source and evidence manifest
acquisition_protocol.future_updates: append-only by new trading date; existing dates and hashes cannot be overwritten
